author: Subscriptor
body:
Nexus sub gamemode that has a big, not necessarily symmetrical map that has structures. 
FFA stands for Free For All, which means every player is against the other. In this gamemode teaming should be punishable. Also, in my opinion this p gamemode shouldn't has a separate rotation for itself since nexus isn't that popular but I hope this gamemode will bring some players to nexus. 
NexusFFA maps should have their own kits and customizable kits, which is the only YML feature you need since it's possible to make A nexus FFA map using our current YML features, but customizable kits and amount should be an easy and cool feature to make.
I heard that nexus FFA was tested already and a map developer mentioned that it played horrible for the avicus standarts. I wasn't there when the map was tested, but I can assume that the problem is most likely the map they played, just give more chances to players to create a map for that. I think the gamemode would bee a great addition for avicus, and you don't need to develops a lot for nexus FFA, you should just add a customizable kit feature.


Opinions?
